mentions.name: Zookeeper
mentions.description: A simple time tracking app for tasks that helps users understand how they spend their working days. Everything is stored locally, requires no login, and has no backend sync.
mentions.problem: Wanting a better understanding of how working days are spent.
mentions.audience: Personal use; explicitly not intended for tracking employees
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a time tracking app for tasks. I built it because I want to gain a better understanding of how I spend my working days. It's meant to be very simple. Everything is stored locally and requires no login. I don't currently plan to sync it with any backend. This isn't something that can be used to track employees — it's just for personal use.
